name: Storefront browse and filters
expected: Catalog renders, filters and search work, and product details show their reviews.

name: Customer shopping persistence
expected: Customer cart, favorites, orders and profile persist across sessions.

name: Owner administration
expected: Only the configured owner can manage products, customers and orders.

name: Review eligibility
expected: Only a customer with a delivered purchase can review the purchased product.

name: Security and OMNIX gate
expected: Private data stays private, admin routes are protected, and invalid OMNIX codes are denied.
